lines.text: Since last time, how is the hip?
Since last time it's a vague, dull ache deep in the left hip.
Not too sure, there's some tingling in the foot now and then.
And how are you sleeping since last time?
I dunno, since last time the hip wakes me twice a night.
It's pretty tight through the glutes, so I'll do some needles there today.
Book in for next week and we'll recheck it then.
